Pakistan threatens India over Indus Waters Treaty amid dispute

Pakistan has issued threats to India regarding the Indus Waters Treaty, escalating a dispute over water sharing. Pakistani officials have stated the treaty is valid and binding, while also warning of severe consequences if India takes action. The situation highlights ongoing tensions between the two nations concerning water resources.
